title: The text discusses the convening of a Sovereign National Conference in Nigeria, which the government is refusing to convene despite calls from various groups. Dr. Beko, a human rights activist, states that the government is defying the people by refusing to hold the conference to address pressing national issues. General Abdulsalami Abubakar, a former military leader, is criticized for being insincere and untrustworthy due to his past actions and affiliations. Additionally, the commander of Operation Sweep in Lagos, Lt. Col. Minimah, warns that the next time a group confronts or provokes the operation, they will be dealt with decisively.
